functions.name: HWInputExit

Logs an entry debug message, destructs two collision objects (this+1121 and this+866), cleans up the cursor resource (this+815) and collision culling (this+1), releases the DirectInput device via its vtable Release method and clears the stored pointer, then — when a global render flag is 1 — unloads the input module and marks this+0x1B10 as -1.

functions.name: TextLineWrappingAndRendering
functions.summary: Renders a text line with word wrap onto an output context. When the special color marker 16909060 is passed as the color parameter, maps it to a render color mask via IDToColorMaskMapper. While the remaining text is at least 80 characters, copies 79-character segments, cuts each at the last space boundary after position 40 (or at 79 when no space found), and renders the segment via UtilityFunction_b9c0. Finally renders the remaining text. Skips rendering when the width/size parameter exceeds the global bound dword_7D02E4. Part of the UI/text rendering subsystem.

Choose the wrap point length: last space index + 1 when a space was found after position 40, otherwise the full 79-char segment.

Truncate the segment at the wrap point and render it via UtilityFunction_b9c0 with the output context (*this), color, fixed parameter 1084227584 and width parameter a3; advance the consumed text offset.
